_comment: How rtc-ship.sh ships THIS repo (run-to-completion's bin/rtc-ship.sh). Data lives here; commands a repo needs live in .rtc/*.sh, opt-in by presence. Adding this file is config-only: no version bump, no release.
_comment_tests: No pytest suite: the gate runs the node suite (node --test is file-parallel by default). The CLI tests run in a temp HOME with DRY_RUN=1, so the gate never reads real transcripts or plays audio (2026-10-28).
